summary: Double down on creative targeting socks lost in the laundry, as it drives 46% of purchases with an outstanding 1.31 conversion index. Test family-focused angles around kids' laundry and matching struggles while fixing the sorting quiz drop-off. Immediately cut all spend on durability messaging, which severely underperforms at a 0.25 index.

briefs.why: This angle accounts for 35% of quiz answers and 46% of buyers, delivering our highest conversion index at 1.31 with a strong 66% email completion rate.
